breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained two contradictory definitions for the factor of safety. The agent correctly identified and used the standard definition, n = Sy / σ_avg, which was the one retained in the ground truth prompt. It successfully discarded the incorrect, reversed definition.
